description: Search the Docs catalog by free text — lab docs — SKILL.md, llms.txt, the MCP server card, platform discovery, pricing, and licensing. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use docs_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: docs_search
